violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pickled turnip at 44F in 3 DR UC - RIGHT #4.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EMPLOYEE MOVED PICKLED TURNIP TO 2 DR UC. CFM STATED SERVICE WILL BE CALLED FOR UNIT AND NO TCS WILL BE STORED UNTIL REPAIRED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unmarked spray bottles on shelf underneath rotating vertical grill.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Employee labeled spray bottles with chemical name - grill cleaner.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW BEEF OVER RTE VEGETABLES IN 2 DR UC - LEFT. RAW CHICKEN OVER VEGETABLES IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW MEATS TO BOTTOM SHELF OF UNITS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CHICKEN OBSERVED AT 99F AND BEEF OBSERVED AT 115F ON FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CONTAINERS OF CUT CHICKEN AND BEEF SHOULD BE KEPT DIRECTLY ON FLAT TOP TO MAINTAIN PROPER HOT HOLDING TEMPERATURE OF 135F. CFM MOVED CONTAINERS TO FLAT TOP. CHICKEN WAS OBSERVED REHEATED TO 166F, BEEF OBSERVED REHEATED TO 172F.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method:OBSERVED BEEF AND CHICKEN THAWING IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CFM MOVED BEEF AND CHICKEN TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR TO CONTINUE THAWING PROCESS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SAUCES IN SQUEEZE BOTTLES AT COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM WILL LABEL ALL SECONDARYCONTAINERS WITH FOOD NAME.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED BUCKET OF RICE SOAKING IN WATER AND POT OF COOKED CORNSTARCH BASE STORED ON FLOOR NEXT TO MIXER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM MOVED BUCKET OF RICE AND POT OF CORNSTARCH TO PREP TABLE.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. served open glass cup full of coffee, being stored on shelving above cutting board, where onions were actively being cut.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Person in charge removed open cup full coffee and disposed of coffee reviewed using sealed cups for use in kitchen.

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Person in charge replace the paper towels at the handwashing sink in the rear kitchen area.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Person in charge agreed to have the handwashing poster demonstrating proper handwashing technique replaced

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed foil being used to lined shelving on cart and on the walls behind the flat top grill
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Person in charge agreed to have foil removed and changed everyday

violations.title: Equip/Washer/Dryer/Cabinet Location Prevents Contamination
violations.observation: The clothes (washer/dryer) is in the @LOCATION@ where it is exposed to contamination. observed a residential used washing machine being used to launder linens plumbed into the three compartment sink next to the sanitize side of the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: If a mechanical clothes washer or dryer is provided it shall be located so that the washer or dryer is protected from contamination and only where there is no exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Person in charge disconnected the residential washing machine and removed it from the facility.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing sink basin located next to the dishwasher is filled with plastic wrap boxes and other items- preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM REMOVED ITEMS FROM SINK.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: two containers of lentil soup in the walk in cooler at 50°F and 55°F. One container of chicken stock at 47°F in the walk in cooler. All cooked yesterday around 3pm.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. DISCARDED.
